## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix "Restore the empty-criteria guard in requirement_proven" before merge: the rewrite reports a requirement with no criteria as proven, reversing the base behavior. This review read the tests and did not run them.

## Changes
The pull request rewrites `requirement_proven` in `app/proof.py` to count proven items, and adds a `reviewed_batch` helper that raises `ValueError` on an empty batch plus an unused `REVIEW_HINT` constant. It also adds `tests/test_proof.py`, which covers both functions.

## Critical
- app/proof.py:3 — correctness — Restore the empty-criteria guard in requirement_proven — `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True`, because the sum over no items is 0 and `len([])` is 0. The replaced line returned `False` for the same input through its `bool(criteria)` guard. — Callers receive a proven status for a requirement that has no criteria, and no added test exercises the empty list. — Fix: Return `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` and extend `test_requirement_with_evidence` with the empty-list case.
